meta.name: migrate-nanoclaw
meta.description: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. Replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 fork 的自定义迁移到上游版本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果维护着一个上游项目的 fork，想升级又不丢失自定义改动。
copy.tagline_en: Migrate fork customizations to upstream releases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a fork of an upstream project and want to upgrade without losing custom changes.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会提取你对NanoClaw fork的个性化修改（如配置、源文件、角色、技能等），生成一份可重放的迁移指南。当上游更新时，它拉取干净的上游代码，按指南重新应用你的修改，从而避免合并冲突。
howto.when: 当你提到要升级NanoClaw或处理上游更新时触发。它会自动检查工作目录是否干净，然后引导你完成提取和升级两个阶段。

say.text: 提取我的自定义修改到迁移指南。
检查上游更新并重新应用我的修改。

howto.what_en: Upon installation, Claude extracts customizations from your NanoClaw fork, creates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. This replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention upgrading NanoClaw or handling upstream updates. It automatically checks for a clean working tree and guides you through Extract and Upgrade phases.

say_en.text: Upgrade my NanoClaw to the latest version.
Extract my customizations into a migration guide.
Check for upstream updates and reapply my changes.
